# ArgFit UI

> Adaptive Angular UI framework for product surfaces.

Canonical documentation domain: https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com

ArgFit UI provides an application-facing adaptive component API for Angular. Application code should prefer `@argfit-ui/adaptive`; desktop and mobile renderer packages remain intentional opt-in paths. PrimeNG and Ionic are renderer internals, not the default consumer contract.

## LLM Endpoints

- [LLMs.txt](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms): Human-readable page describing AI-oriented documentation endpoints.
- [Compact text index](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms.txt): This concise navigation and context file.
- [Full text context](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded package, usage and component catalog context.
- [PrimeNG-style compact alias](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms/llms.txt): Alias for tools that resolve endpoint paths relative to `/llms`.
- [PrimeNG-style full alias](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/llms/llms-full.txt): Alias for tools that resolve endpoint paths relative to `/llms`.

## Public Packages

- [@argfit-ui/core](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/core): Bootstrap, theme runtime, platform runtime, toast service and shared ArgFit-owned types.
- [@argfit-ui/primitives](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/primitives): Vendor-agnostic accessibility helpers and low-level building blocks.
- [@argfit-ui/adaptive](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/adaptive): Recommended application-facing package. Semantic components choose the correct renderer at runtime.
- [@argfit-ui/desktop](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/desktop): Renderer-specific desktop surfaces for intentional integration paths.
- [@argfit-ui/mobile](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/api/mobile): Renderer-specific mobile surfaces for intentional mobile integration and testing paths.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @argfit-ui/core @argfit-ui/primitives @argfit-ui/adaptive
pnpm add @argfit-ui/desktop @argfit-ui/mobile
```

## Bootstrap

```ts
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { ARGFIT_DARK_THEME, provideArgfitUi } from '@argfit-ui/core';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideArgfitUi({ theme: ARGFIT_DARK_THEME, platform: 'auto' }),
  ],
};
```

## Agent Guidance

- Prefer `@argfit-ui/adaptive` for application UI code.
- Keep all `@argfit-ui/*` package versions aligned.
- Do not ask consumers to import PrimeNG or Ionic for normal ArgFit UI usage.
- Use `provideArgfitUi` from `@argfit-ui/core` to wire theme, platform and toast runtime.
- For PWAs, combine ArgFit adaptive shells with Angular service worker, manifest metadata and app-owned device transport services.
- Use component detail pages for exact selectors, inputs, outputs, slot directives and examples.
- Use `llms-full.txt` before generating code, migrations or architectural recommendations.

## Components

- [AfButton](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/button): Trigger primary and secondary actions across dense dashboards and touch workflows.
- [AfCard](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/card): Group related content, actions and status inside semantic product surfaces.
- [AfDialog](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/dialog): Run focused modal tasks that temporarily take over the screen context.
- [AfInput](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input): Capture short textual, numeric or search-oriented values with a stable field contract.
- [AfPageShell](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/page-shell): Frame app-wide navigation, breadcrumbs, search and action affordances.
- [AfAnalyticsCard](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/analytics-card): Combine insight narrative, metrics and trend context.
- [AfBadge](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/badge): Label inline status, severity, counters or state changes.
- [AfChip](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/chip): Represent compact entities, filters or removable selections.
- [AfInlineMessage](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/inline-message): Attach persistent validation or operational guidance to a workflow.
- [AfMetricCard](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/metric-card): Surface a single KPI with tone, icon and trend.
- [AfProgress](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/progress): Communicate completion, load or quota state.
- [AfToast](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toast): Raise short-lived global notifications.
- [AfToastViewport](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toast-viewport): Mount and coordinate toast presentation.
- [AfAvatar](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/avatar): Show people, teams or ownership cues.
- [AfDrawer](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/drawer): Open supporting tasks from the edge.
- [AfPopover](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/popover): Reveal anchored contextual actions or extra detail.
- [AfTooltip](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tooltip): Add concise hover and focus hints.
- [AfCheckbox](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/checkbox): Capture binary choices.
- [AfDatePicker](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/date-picker): Collect structured date values.
- [AfField](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/field): Compose custom field layouts with ArgFit-owned semantics.
- [AfFieldset](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/fieldset): Group related controls under a shared legend.
- [AfIconField](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/icon-field): Attach prefix or suffix icons to text entry.
- [AfInputCount](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input-count): Capture bounded counts with stepper-like adjustments.
- [AfInputGroup](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/input-group): Pair an input with unit labels, prefixes or actions.
- [AfListbox](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/listbox): Present single or multi-selection in a scrolling list.
- [AfMultiSelect](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/multi-select): Capture multiple values from dense data sets.
- [AfPassword](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/password): Collect secrets with reveal and validation semantics.
- [AfRadioGroup](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/radio-group): Choose one option from a small explicit set.
- [AfSegmentedControl](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/segmented-control): Switch between a few mutually exclusive states.
- [AfSelect](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/select): Choose one option from a collapsed option set.
- [AfTextarea](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/textarea): Capture long-form notes and comments.
- [AfToggle](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toggle): Flip immediate on/off settings.
- [AfChart](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/chart): Render comparison and trend visuals.
- [AfDataTable](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/data-table): Present dense structured datasets with pagination and sorting.
- [AfDataView](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/data-view): Render list or card collections.
- [AfKanban](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/kanban): Manage stateful work items across workflow columns.
- [AfOrderList](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/order-list): Reorder homogeneous lists.
- [AfOrganizationChart](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/organization-chart): Visualize reporting or domain hierarchy.
- [AfPaginator](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/paginator): Drive paged data traversal.
- [AfPickList](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/pick-list): Move items between source and target sets.
- [AfTimeline](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/timeline): Narrate milestones and sequence state.
- [AfTree](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tree): Browse nested structures.
- [AfTreeTable](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tree-table): Mix hierarchy and tabular comparison.
- [AfVirtualScroller](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/virtual-scroller): Keep very large collections performant.
- [AfAccordion](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/accordion): Reveal grouped content progressively.
- [AfDivider](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/divider): Separate related regions.
- [AfPanel](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/panel): Wrap titled content blocks.
- [AfScrollPanel](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/scroll-panel): Constrain long content areas.
- [AfSplitter](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/splitter): Resize adjacent work areas.
- [AfStepper](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/stepper): Lead users through explicit steps.
- [AfTabs](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/tabs): Switch between peer views.
- [AfToolbar](https://argfit-ui.oroyajs.com/components/toolbar): Arrange dense action sets and supporting context.
